t: High efficiency airless paint sprayer for use with oil and water-based paints, varnishes, stains, and wood preservatives. 360° spray orientation allows for use on a multitude of projects, including hard to reach areas. Adjustable flow rate and spray pressure allow precise regulation of the paint flow according to the task. Direct intake from the paint container removes the need to decant or refill. Fitted with a wide base stand for increased stability during operation. Supplied with cleaning brush, spanners and screw set for the base stand.
b: Suitable for Solvent & Water-Based Paints & Varnishes
